description: A seven-channel stereo mixer, each channel with a level, a pan, a high-pass cut, mute and solo, summed through a master into a soft-limited stereo pair.

params.text: Puts a 180Hz high-pass in that channel's path, on both sides.
Places that channel in the stereo image, -1 hard left to +1 hard right, using equal-power gains; on a stereo channel it works as a balance, attenuating one side rather than moving the other.
Sets that channel's level, 0 to 10 on the knob for silence to unity.
Takes that channel out of the mix.
Leaves only the soloed channels in the mix; with any solo on, every channel without one is dropped.
Sets the level of the summed mix before the limiter, 0 to 100.

inputs.text: The left side of that channel's input; with nothing in its right jack this one feeds both sides.
The right side of that channel's input; with nothing in its left jack this one feeds both sides.
Scales that channel's VOL knob, 0V to 10V for none to whatever the knob is set to; the knob becomes the ceiling rather than the level.
Takes over that channel's pan knob while a cable is here, -5V hard left to +5V hard right.

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, soft-limited by a tanh to about ±5V.
The right side of the mix, soft-limited by a tanh to about ±5V.

notes: Both the channel VOL knobs and the MASTER slider come up at zero, so a newly placed module is silent until you turn up a channel and the master.
A mute always wins over a solo: a channel that is both muted and soloed stays out of the mix.
The two columns of lamps beside the master read the output after the limiter, five segments a side.
